Classes

Description

The futuram.classes subpackage contains the classes used to define the objects in the model.

These classes are:

  • futuram.classes.model.Model (this is the main class and can contain all the other classes)

  • futuram.classes.processes.Process (these are inserted to the class ‘Model’)

  • futuram.classes.flows.Flow (these are inserted to the class ‘Process’)

  • futuram.classes.matter.Matter (these are inserted to the class ‘Flow’)

  • futuram.classes.parameters.Parameter (these can be act on all the other classes)

The class ‘Matter’ is a superclass with the following subclasses:

  • futuram.classes.matter.Product

  • futuram.classes.matter.Component

  • futuram.classes.matter.Material

  • futuram.classes.matter.Compound

  • futuram.classes.matter.Element

Details

See the API reference for more information on the modules and their functions.
